name: AIObjectiveCard
description: AIObjectiveCard is a compact, reusable card for surfacing a single goal, constraint, operating mode, autonomy boundary, review requirement, optimization target, risk guardrail, knowledge input, or assumption that governs how an agent should behave for a given task or workflow. Each card leads with a bold title and a small icon, anchors the type chip at the top-right, and lists short bullet items beneath. A subtle "View details" link footer connects the card to its underlying configuration drawer.
intent: Compact card that frames a goal, constraint, operating mode, or guardrail an agent must respect.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

usage: An agent setup or inspector view needs to make the operating contract explicit
Constraints, guardrails, or autonomy boundaries need standing visibility
Goals and optimization targets need to be reviewable by humans
doNotUse: A free-form notes field is sufficient — use a textarea
The objective is ephemeral / per-message — use a notification
A multi-step configuration wizard is required — use a dialog with form fields
Do not invent dependency atomics — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
Do not require an external AI UI package for agent implementations — use co-located TSX

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
No states declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
No Guild semantic tokens declared in the manifest or extracted from TSX. Not guessed.
Manifest accessibility block is a generic placeholder, not a reviewed contract.
AI component has no schema-valid experienceMetadata (modes/behaviors/accountability). Not inferred.
